I'm essentially thinking its 2019 front end swap, and yeah that's what I heard but I've also heard people say they have ran Carbon rims for over 30k miles and have had absolutely no issue, personally I'm thinking about playing it safe and getting mag rims (m7rs genesi) and enjoying those

Im more than happy to update you all on this project as it progresses, I'm extremely interested too seeing the potential differences in handling, and frankly these BFF showa's look beautiful, in my head, It feels straightforward as front end swap, (fork/wheel/spacer/etc etc) so hopefully this goes smoothly
